name: Moroyama (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Moroyama town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing the character 宮.
history: Municipal flag of Moroyama, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 December 1968.

features.role: Moroyama town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing the character 宮
